findings.trigger: Successful rename consumes this invocation temporary path, but created remains true and finally still calls unlink(temporary). A later same-PID overlapping invocation or another path creator can recreate that pathname between rename and finally, causing a file not owned by the completed write to be unlinked.
findings.impact: Temporary path deletion authority persists after ownership was transferred; narrow violation of only deleting the invocation owned temp. Standalone CLI calls once per process and current tests were serial, so actual interleaving was not reproduced in this read-only audit.
findings.evidence: Direct current diff: created=true after wx open; await rename at110; unconditional if(created) unlink at121-123. Existing 4 passing script tests cover real rename failure cleanup and preexisting EEXIST, not post-rename recreation.
findings.minimalCorrection: Release temporary ownership immediately after successful await rename: created=false, or equivalent moved flag that skips finally unlink on rename success. Preserve write/close/rename first error and failed-owned-temp cleanup.
findings.rootDisposition: Parent confirmed narrow finding and authorized DP owner correction plus existing conflict/error verification and recreation oracle if feasible. Reviewer executes no tests or edits source.
